acs.text_first_line: AC1 A confirmed booking stamps booked_at and moves the treatment to BOOKED
AC2 Differing terms are held on the treatment and the state does not move
AC3 A missing booking writes nothing on the treatment
AC4 A repeated write is deduped and returns the recorded answer
AC5 A failed record write rolls the whole step back
AC6 No package version in force is a refusal and nothing changes
AC7 The approved-not-booked read serves the run for a business date
AC8 The booked treatment and its difference show on SCR-14 through the composite route
AC9 No personal data in the request, the record, the row or the logs

ops_provided: GET /api/recovery/treatment/v1/treatments/{treatmentId} with booked_at (DF-TRT-012), booking_difference (DF-TRT-028) and the state (API-S2-002 shape; this story serves the booking elements)
GET the approved-not-booked list of a treatment type set and a business date; name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2691; ASM-4444)
POST the mark-booked write (treatment ID, business date, booking reference, account facts, row ID, package version); name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2691; ASM-4444)

POST the booking-difference write (treatment ID, business date, differing terms with approved and booked value, row ID, package version); name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2691; ASM-4444)
ops_consumed: the parameters read of RWB-P3-E1042-CON for booking.missing.grace_loads, operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2691; ASM-4444)
the reference-data read of RWB-P3-E1043-CON for LOV-TREATMENT and the outcome codes, operation name Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2691; ASM-4444)
events_published: rwb.decision-record.DecisionRecorded.v1 on rwb.decision-record.v1, written by the DP-03 record library in the step transaction
